pumi.workflow.v1.Invoke.jsonschema.json.description: Invoke is an entry that starts an invocation (decision 0168).

^(model_role)$.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "implementer", which the
 configuration maps to a model and a fallback model at the model
 gateway. A state that starts a harness names one; a state that starts
 a check or an external action names none (decision 0233).

^(output_message)$.description:
The full name of the protobuf message in the api module that the
 invocation's structured output must be, such as
 pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput (decision 0160).

^(returns_tree)$.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, as the
 archive step's does (decisions 0278 and 0282). The runner drops the
 file changes of a check without it. Only a state that starts a check
 may set it.

component.description:
The component name of a check, such as "spec", by which the
 configuration names the check's program (decision 0272). A state that
 starts a check names one; a state that starts a harness or an external
 action names none.

coverage.description:
Whether the kernel adds the coverage report of the plan's change, with
 the plan's reasons for having no test, to the task of an agent run
 (decisions 0280, 0295 and 0298). Only a state that starts a harness may
 set it.

modelRole.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "implementer", which the
 configuration maps to a model and a fallback model at the model
 gateway. A state that starts a harness names one; a state that starts
 a check or an external action names none (decision 0233).

narratives.description:
Whether the kernel adds the narratives of the plan's change and of the
 capabilities it touches, from the spec check's result, to the task of
 an agent run (decisions 0271, 0279 and 0298). Only a state that starts
 a harness may set it.

outputMessage.description:
The full name of the protobuf message in the api module that the
 invocation's structured output must be, such as
 pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput (decision 0160).

returnsTree.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, as the
 archive step's does (decisions 0278 and 0282). The runner drops the
 file changes of a check without it. Only a state that starts a check
 may set it.

task.description:
The id of the task, such as "plan" or "review-plan". The task's text is
 its own file beside the workflow file.
